high_level_description: The image is a satellite weather map showing the Atlantic Ocean and parts of the Caribbean Sea. It highlights two significant weather systems: Imelda: Located near the southeastern coast of the United States, Imelda appears as a large area of intense activity with bright yellow and orange colors, indicating strong winds and heavy precipitation. The system is shown to be strengthening as it moves towards the US coast. Twin Storms: To the east of Imelda, there is another area of intense weather activity, which is described as preparing for twin storms.
